dedupe_keys.name: commerce commission telecommunications connectivity map coverage of every broadband technology in new zealand with geopackage downloads

description: The Commerce Commission's telecommunications connectivity map shows the coverage of all broadband technologies in New Zealand and the make-up of connections in geographic areas. Technologies include fibre, ADSL, VDSL, HFC cable, cellular 3G, 4G and 5G, and non-cellular wireless, and users can search by address to see what is available at a location and which connection technologies consumers have chosen in an area. Broadband providers supply the coverage and connection data, which reflect conditions on 30 June 2025, and the Commission plans to update the map once a year as part of its monitoring. Downloads include aggregated connection data as XLSX, coverage for each of 11 technologies as zipped GeoPackage files, and a list of providers. Coverage: New Zealand. Format and access: web map with XLSX and GeoPackage downloads, free. Caveats: accuracy depends on the quality of the data providers supplied; coverage is as reported, not measured; licence terms were not stated in the page summary read. Simulation uses: technology-specific coverage layers to find areas relying on a single network, and exposure of connections to earthquakes, floods and storms. Related records: the Commerce Commission annual monitoring gives market time series, Measuring Broadband New Zealand gives measured performance, and the RSM radio register gives licensed sites.
